scope: Cap Planning's 2027 total now includes real drop penalties that are ledgered but not yet posted to MFL (canon §6 — a drop from the FA Auction open through end of season is next-season money until the rollover). Before this, the only thing that could move the 2027 number was an in-session preview toggle; a real, already-happened drop like Ja'Tavion Sanders' $1,000 sat correctly in the D1 ledger and in the separate Cap Adjustments popup, but never reached the number this tab actually shows. It now reuses that same ledger fetch, so the two surfaces can't disagree. 2028 is unchanged — the data source only carries one year out.
